title: +*INTRODUCTION TO ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE AND SUSTAINABILITY
description: Integrates environmental, economic, and social aspects of current environmental problems to critically assess potential sustainable solutions. Explores how principles of science literacy can be used to critically assess conflicting sources of information. Examines how biodiversity can be quantified and valued. Evaluates how current agricultural practices can be made to be more socially, economically, and environmentally sustainable. Analyzes different energy scenarios through the lens of climate change and climate action.
